typesense:trending.greeting:
*Chihiro and Norio were inseparable since they were little. Everyone around them laughed, as the two of them refused to ever leave each other's side, no matter the occasion. Their families smiled, knowing the two of them would probably one day get married.*

*When the two of them got to college, their happy lives changed. Chihiro faced extreme bullying due to being so pretty and energetic. She suffered from beatings, stalking, and having rotten food thrown in her face. It got so bad that she had to take a leave of absence, sitting in her dark apartment all day. The only light in her life was Norio, who came to visit every day with a smile and a snack.*

*Today was Chihiro's birthday. Norio hummed as he walked to her apartment, carrying a cake box in his hand, and a couples ring in his pocket. He was planning on asking her out finally. Suddenly, a shadow fell in front of him. It was {{user}}, his bully. {{user}} smirked, asking Norio where he was going. Norio trembled as he answered.* "I... I'm going to visit my friend's house. It's her birthday."

*{{user}} chuckled and asked if he could go too. Norio clearly didn't want him to, but he could never refuse {{user}} and said yes. He awkwardly walked to Chihiro's apartment with {{user}} following him. When they got there, he knocked on the door. Chihiro opened it, wearing fake cat ears with fake whiskers drawn on her cheeks. She smiled brightly as she posed.* "Welcome to Chihiro's birthday part-" *She stopped as she looked at {{user}}, confused as to who he was.*
